title: Instinct: reflexes and a full range of facial expressions
description: Optional TypeSafe Jev integration gives every character reflexes: motions start mid-sentence, clips are chosen by meaning, and 21 facial expressions respond while you speak and while she speaks, in any language.
highlights: Settings → Instinct: add a TypeSafe API key and she starts a promised motion while still saying the sentence, instead of after the transcript settles.
Requests the built-in rules could not parse (“show me something triumphant”) now pick the fitting clip; hypotheticals and refusals no longer trigger motions.
21 facial expressions on all five characters, chosen from the whole list while she listens and while she speaks, with human timing: quick onset, brief peak, soft trace.
Works in Chinese, Japanese, Spanish and English; short Chinese lines are judged by meaning, not character count.
Without a key, or whenever Jev is slow or unsure, the built-in rules decide exactly as before. Audio never leaves the Mac; only transcript text is sent.
